Same projected SELECT recomputes row hash and count in every plan/backup/restore/apply/exclude path. All other QR fields, rows, other tables, catalog/ACL/RLS/programs/sequence remain bound. Setup never writes QR leases. Full encrypted pg_dump and actual restore/rehearsal unchanged; existing session HMAC/ENV credential/flags/nonce checks remain mandatory.
dependency_review_notes.tests/integration/test_admin_identity_op: Read all original operator cases plus three lease regressions. Real PG positive renews before backup and after rehearsal, checks fresh full QR row remains byte/value identical after setup. Negative case mutates ten identity/configuration fields and revokes owner membership; old approval fails before backup. Post-rehearsal revision mutation fails source preservation without domain writes. Fake bridge/provider only.
dependency_review_notes.tests/unit/test_admin_demo_setup.py: Read all original nine config/proof cases and new pure three-process/hash-seed regression. Stable snapshot/plan hashes; only four lease fields tolerated. QR identity/tenant/label/owner/revision/credentials/allowlist/idempotency/fingerprint/creation timestamp plus other-table rows/session/credential binding remain protected.
